create_appconfig_from_env: create an AppConfig instance by loading all sub-configs from environment variables
create_appconfig_with_defaults: create an AppConfig instance using default values for all sub-configs
access_api_config: access the ApiConfig sub-config from an AppConfig instance to get API settings
access_cache_config: access the CacheConfig sub-config from an AppConfig instance to get cache settings
access_queue_config: access the QueueConfig sub-config from an AppConfig instance to get queue settings
